pro-master-mechanical-mayville.description: Pro-Master Mechanical is an automotive and mechanical service business serving motorists in Pretoria. Its Mayville location provides convenient access for motorists from Mayville and surrounding Pretoria suburbs. arctig-weavind-park.description: Arctig is a privately owned steel construction and engineering company based in Weavind Park, Pretoria. Established in 2015, the company specialises in structural steel design, fabrication and installation for construction and engineering applications. Arctig provides a range of manufacturing and engineering capabilities, including steel structure manufacturing, pipe fitting, specialised welding, plasma cutting, cut-to-size services, product development and contract work. This combination of design, fabrication and installation capabilities allows Arctig to support projects from the manufacturing stage through to on-site installation. The company works within the broader construction and engineering sectors and focuses on delivering steel solutions tailored to individual project requirements. Based at 141 Cresswell Road in Weavind Park, Arctig is positioned within Pretoria's established industrial and manufacturing area. Its combination of engineering expertise, fabrication capability and specialised metalworking services makes it a relevant supplier for construction companies, engineering firms, contractors and other businesses requiring professionally manufactured steel components and structures.

m-t-a-neon-signs-hesteapark.description: M T A Neon Signs is a Pretoria-based signage business located at 457 Horn Street in Wolmer. As its name suggests, the business specialises in neon signage and operates within the signage and sign-making industry. Public business directories classify M T A Neon Signs under signage and sign-maker services. The company has also been associated with graphic design work, highlighting the creative and visual-design side of its signage services. M T A Neon Signs has an established presence in the Pretoria North area and has been associated with the local signage industry for many years. Businesses looking to improve their visibility through custom signage can use M T A Neon Signs for signage-related enquiries, with the company particularly relevant to customers interested in illuminated and neon-style signs. Its Wolmer location makes it conveniently positioned to serve businesses across Pretoria North and surrounding areas.

lc-ceilings-and-drywall-dorandia.description: LC Ceilings and Drywall is a building contractor based in Dorandia, Pretoria North, specialising in ceiling and drywall installation. The business focuses on interior construction work such as renovations, alterations and finishing, fitting ceilings and drywall partitions as part of broader building projects. It serves residential homeowners and property owners undertaking renovations or alterations, and its classification as a building contractor means it can also take on larger construction and renovation projects beyond individual household jobs. The business is listed in Pretoria's Building & Construction category, trading from 745 Ciliaris Street in Dorandia, Pretoria North. It suits homeowners planning a ceiling replacement, drywall partition or renovation, as well as property owners and contractors who need ceiling and drywall work carried out as part of a wider building or alteration project.

kolletjies-kafee-sinoville.description: Kolletjies Kafee is a neighbourhood café, convenience shop and takeaway outlet at Sinoville Corner Shopping Mall on Braam Pretorius Street, serving the surrounding Sinoville, Magalieskruin, Montana and Wonderboom communities. It offers takeaway meals and everyday convenience items, and customer reviews frequently single out its slap chips as among the best in the area, alongside dishes such as hake and chips, prego rolls and sphatlho. The café has a long-standing local character: reviews describe it as having served the community for many years, with ownership changing hands over time while it has continued operating as an independent neighbourhood business rather than a franchise. It trades from early morning into the evening on most days, making it a practical stop for breakfast, lunch, a quick takeaway or everyday essentials. Kolletjies Kafee suits locals after an affordable meal on the go as well as residents picking up convenience items close to home.

europcar-wonderboom-airport-wonderboom.description: Europcar Wonderboom Airport is a car-rental branch of the Europcar South Africa network, serving travellers who need a vehicle after flying into Wonderboom Airport as well as local Pretoria residents and businesses. The branch offers hire for personal travel, holidays, airport transfers and local transport, alongside corporate and business-rental services for companies needing vehicles for staff, clients or business trips. Rentals can include extras such as child seats, GPS equipment and additional drivers, depending on availability. The branch is at Wonderboom Airport on Lintveldt Road, Annlin, Pretoria North, and is listed as a Deliver/Collect location, so delivery and collection can be arranged through the branch when booking. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturday from 8am to 1pm, and closed on Sundays and public holidays. It suits travellers who want to collect a rental car directly at the airport rather than travelling into central Pretoria.

makro-liquor-wonderboom-annlin-west.description: Makro Liquor Wonderboom is a dedicated liquor outlet operating alongside the main Makro store at 270 Lavender Road, Annlin West, Pretoria. As part of the Makro liquor network, it stocks a broad range of beer, wine, spirits and other alcoholic drinks, with Makro's bulk-retail format suiting customers who want to compare a wide selection and buy multiple bottles, cases or packs rather than relying on a small neighbourhood liquor store. The branch serves households buying for everyday use, as well as customers stocking up for parties, functions and other events, and it suits businesses or individuals needing larger beverage quantities. It is listed separately from the main Wonderboom Makro store, with its own trading hours: Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 6pm, Saturday from 8am to 5pm and Sunday from 9am to 3:30pm, slightly shorter than the main store on Sundays.

superspar-renbro-hammanskraal.description: SUPERSPAR Renbro is a full-service supermarket at Shop 12, Renbro Shopping Centre, Old Warmbaths Road, Hammanskraal, offering fresh produce, an in-store bakery, butchery and deli alongside everyday groceries, pantry staples and household essentials. The store primarily serves the Hammanskraal community and surrounding residential areas, handling regular household grocery shopping and larger fresh-food purchases, and offers in-store shopping alongside pickup and delivery. It is part of the Renbro retail centre, where the same local retail group also runs Renbro TOPS. It trades from 7am to 7pm Monday to Saturday, and from 7am to 4pm on Sundays.

loydrills-monavoni.description: Loydrills is a technology business based at 525 Granite Crescent, Sand Stone Estate, Monavoni, Centurion. superspar-moreleta-moreleta-park.description: SUPERSPAR Moreleta is a full-service supermarket at 926 Rubenstein Drive in Moreleta Park, offering everyday groceries, fresh produce, meat, bakery and deli items, prepared foods and household essentials. autocool-services-heuweloord.description: AutoCool Services is an automotive air-conditioning specialist at 16 Black Wattle Avenue, Heuweloord, Centurion. Its specialist focus on automotive air conditioning, rather than general repairs, is what distinguishes it in the Heuweloord area, making it a practical choice for motorists who specifically want an air-conditioning specialist rather than a general mechanic.
